messages:
Rina S.: Quick one before I submit expenses from the Munich offsite: we had a bunch of small outlays (metro cards, snacks, a couple of tip envelopes) plus I paid an extra-driver fee on the rental using my card. Also one teammate asked for a cash advance earlier but didn't spend all of it. How should I record the leftover advance?
Maya (People Ops): Short answers: extra-driver fee = actuals (attach rental invoice line). Metro/snacks = actual receipts when available, otherwise per-diem only for meals (not transit). Tips can be claimed as actuals if on receipt or covered by per-diem if within the meal per-diem and you didn't claim meal receipts that day. Leftover advance = record as "advance returned" with bank transfer proof or reduce the reimbursement request by the unspent amount.
Omar (Finance): Add: if you returned cash, either: 1) submit a negative expense for the returned amount with "advance return" note and attach proof (bank transfer screenshot, Venmo/wise id), or 2) indicate "net reimbursement" in the expense form and show calculation. We avoid separate manual refunds when simple netting works.
Priya K.: For the extra-driver, the rental company gave a short receipt that doesn't list company name. Is that enough for reimbursement and VAT reclaim?
Maya (People Ops): For reimbursement yes if it shows date, merchant, amount. For VAT reclaim Finance needs invoice in company name. If vendor won't reissue, flag "VAT reclaim" and Finance will assess — likely unrecoverable in many countries for incidentals.
ExpenseBot: :receipt: Missing receipt rules: <= $25 lost-receipt form; $25-$75 lost-receipt + manager approval; > $75 original receipt required. Required fields: date, merchant, amount, currency. Prefer JPEG/PNG or PDF.
Rina S.: What about cash returned after the fact? I collected €18 back from one person in cash and didn't deposit it before filing.
Maya (People Ops): Put the €18 as a line item under the original expense as a reimbursement to the company (negative amount) and note "cash returned to payer X on DATE". Attach photo of cash exchange if you have it and manager approval for transparency.
Omar (Finance): Currency: use FX provider rate on transaction date. If you repaid in a different date/currency, we convert that repayment line separately. Keep records tidy.
Priya K.: Any special handling for incidental tips paid in cash with no receipt?
Maya (People Ops): If under $10 and part of a meal day, you can include it within per-diem if you choose per-diem that day. Otherwise file a lost-receipt claim for the tip and manager approval if between $25-$75.
Rina S.: Thanks all 44d I'll net the advance and add notes on the returned cash + attach the short rental receipt.
Maya (People Ops): Sounds good 44d If anything weird pops up, DM People Ops and we'll help route to Finance.
